WORLDLOOM LOADING FOREST

Recorded from the running Worldloom renderer with tools/capture-loading-forest.mjs.
Seed 41; ash tree rooted at (8,35,49); fixed camera at (15,37,59).
Native 3840x2160 at 30 fps. No camera movement, player hand or interface.
Falling leaves, foliage and water are the actual game simulations.
The 12-second capture has a 0.7-second loop dissolve (11.3-second final loop).
Desktop: forest-leaves-4k.mp4. Small screens: forest-leaves-1080.mp4.
Bird ambience uses the original user-provided ../audio/birds-near-trees.mp3,
controlled separately to honor ambience volume and browser audio policy.
